Verify De-Identification Residual PHI and Generate Cryptographic Attestation

Source: R/deid-verify.R
dicom_deid_verify.Rd

Scans DICOM files across four forensic surfaces (tag policy violations, unallowlisted private tags, free-text/structured report PII regexes/canaries, and pixel/WSI artifacts) to verify complete residual PHI elimination. Optionally emits and signs a canonical JSON cryptographic attestation with HMAC-SHA256 or X.509 PKI signatures.

Usage

dicom_deid_verify(
  path,
  profile = "ps3.15",
  options = character(0),
  jurisdictions = NULL,
  canaries = character(0),
  attest_path = NULL,
  key = NULL,
  cert = NULL,
  private_key = NULL,
  allowed_private_tags = NULL
)

Arguments

path

Character vector of one or more DICOM file paths, or a directory path.

profile

Character string identifying the base profile, or a compiled dicom_deid_profile object. Default is "ps3.15".

options

Character vector of standard PS3.15 options enabled during de-identification.

jurisdictions

Optional character vector of statutory jurisdiction overlays.

canaries

Character vector of user-supplied canary strings or identifiers to detect.

attest_path

Optional file path where the signed JSON attestation will be saved.

key

Optional dicom_key_provider or 32-byte raw key used for HMAC-SHA256 attestation signing.

cert

Optional public certificate or public key object for PKI verification.

private_key

Optional private key object (e.g. from openssl::rsa_keygen) for PKI signing.

allowed_private_tags

Optional list or character vector of allowlisted private tags or creators.

Value

An S3 object of class "dicom_deid_report" containing:

passed

Logical scalar. TRUE if zero findings were detected, FALSE otherwise.

findings

A tibble of detected residual PHI violations with columns file, surface, tag, keyword, value, and rule.

files_scanned

Integer count of scanned files.

profile

Profile identifier.

options

Active confidentiality options.

jurisdictions

Active jurisdictions.

attest_path

Path to generated attestation file, or NULL.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
v <- dicom_deid_verify("path/to/clean_dir", canaries = "TAN^AH^KOW")
if (!v$passed) print(v$findings)
} # }
